title: A Temporal Multiplex Graph Neural Network for Systemic Risk Transmission in Global Banking
abstract: arXiv:2608.27295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a unified framework for assessing systemic risk and identifying contagion channels in the global banking system using a Temporal Heterogeneous Multiplex Graph Neural Network. We construct a harmonised quarterly panel combining bank fundamentals, CDS spreads, and macroeconomic indicators, and represent these data as dynamic multiplex networks linking banks through financial similarity and liquidity co-movement, augmented with country-level macroeconomic relationships. The model integrates graph convolutional layers with recurrent GRU dynamics and incorporates a learnable fusion gate to capture time-varying reliance on alternative contagion channels. Empirical results show that the framework outperforms conventional econometric, machine learning, and graph-based benchmarks for short-term changes in CDS spreads. translated_title: 全球银行业系统性风险传播的时间多重图神经网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27295v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本文开发了一个统一框架，用于评估全球银行系统中的系统性风险并识别传染渠道，采用时间异质多重图神经网络。我们构建了一个协调的季度面板，结合银行基本面、CDS利差和宏观经济指标，并将这些数据表示为动态多重网络，通过金融相似性和流动性共同运动连接银行，同时增强国家层面的宏观经济关系。该模型整合了图卷积层与循环GRU动态，并引入了可学习的融合门，以捕捉对替代传染渠道的时间变化依赖。实证结果表明，该框架在CDS利差的短期变化预测上优于传统计量经济学、机器学习和基于图的基准方法。除了预测外，我们提供了一个可解释的框架，通过压力情景量化银行层面的系统性重要性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种时间异质多重图神经网络，统一评估全球银行系统的系统性风险，并通过可学习的融合门动态捕捉传染渠道，优于现有基准预测方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a temporal heterogeneous multiplex graph neural network to uniformly assess systemic risk in global banking, dynamically capturing contagion channels via a learnable fusion gate, outperforming existing benchmarks.
